# Phase 5 visual baselines

Playwright `toHaveScreenshot` files for dark / light / zen / page-manage.

Generated on Linux Chromium (same as CI). Pixel budget is `maxDiffPixelRatio: 0.003` (0.3%).

Update with:

```bash
npx playwright test tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
```

Only refresh these when the homepage look is supposed to change, and say why in the commit message.
